_why: M-07 step 04. Additive, like the aliases: content/source is fingerprinted and stays unedited, so the thirteen ladders arrive alongside it rather than inside it. '11' is absent by design — Sabotage was already set in the ported corpus and is the ceiling the other thirteen were written under.
_invariant_1: ladder[0] equals the chapter's authored silence, in all fourteen. The ladder never contradicts the number the chapter was authored with; it only says what happens after it.
_invariant_2: No rung exceeds Sabotage's corresponding rung [300, 720, 1320]. Sabotage is the only chapter whose subject is the waiting itself.
_not_here: No L4. Rescue is not on a clock — it is reached by the direct-ask count and the escalation path. No change to any authored silence, ask, region or fix.
